messages:
lina: FYI - AzureEdge sent a revised pricing sheet. They want a higher onboarding fee for short commits (30d) and claim latency SLAs justify it. Thoughts?
omar: Can you drop the sheet here? curious about numbers.
lina: pasted snippet from their CSV: `sku,commit_days,onboard_fee_usd,spot_discount,avg_lat_ms
AE-GPU-A100,30,1500,0.10,14
AE-GPU-A100,365,500,0.25,12`
maggie: interesting. So shorter tenor => higher upfront. Makes sense for churn risk but hurts our unit economics for early stage customers.
chris: Also they’re pricing lower spot discounts on 30d which is weird. Should factor into our cost per token calc (spot blend).
vendor-bot: Reminder: partner contract draft v3 uploaded -> https://redwood.svc/contracts/AzureEdge/draft-v3.pdf :paperclip:
omar: Quick back-of-envelope: if onboard fee amortized over expected commit length, 30d -> $1500/day ~ $50/day per GPU? wait lemme calc: 1500/30 = 50. But per-GPU allocation matters.
raj: We usually amortize onboarding across expected lifetime >commit. For 30d we assume 3 month churn multiplier x1.5. If we apply that, effective monthly burden drops but still >365-day case.
sara: Proposal: add a latency-premium line to cost model that explicitly captures SLA uplift they charge. That premium should be optional flag in the pricing engine so sales can toggle when latency is a must-have.
maggie: +1. Also surface onboarding fee separately in our billing preview UI vs burying in per-hour rate. Sales gets transparency.
chris: For modeling: need per-region latency delta + customer acceptance threshold. If latency premium buys 2ms we need to quantify revenue uplift.
inar: (typo) disregard
omar: Could we propose a hybrid: reduce onboarding fee by 40% for 30d if we commit to a 3x repeat purchase clause? i.e., customer signs LOI for 3 30d renewals. That hedges churn risk and lowers initial friction.
lina: I like the hybrid. I'll draft a counter to AzureEdge: ask for 40% onboarding reduction with renewal clause + explicit eviction notice SLA.
raj: Add a fallback credit if preempt eviction >1%/month. That protects us and is easy for them to agree to.
sara: For integration: engineering needs the `onboard_fee_usd` field in the partner CSV ingestion schema. @chris can you add that to the parser?
chris: Yep. I’ll add `onboard_fee_usd` and `latency_sla_ms` fields. Will default to 0 for existing partners.
lina: Action items: 1) lina: counter to AzureEdge with hybrid renewal ask (EOD Fri) 2) chris: schema update and cost-model flag (PR by Tue) 3) raj: draft fallback credit language for contract (Mon) 4) maggie/sales: hold off on quoting short-tenor deals until we have optional latency-premium visible.
omar: also to modelers: include a scenario that amortizes onboarding over 12/6/1 month windows and outputs breakeven for average token price.
sara: pinging legal channel for eviction SLA template: `@legal` please review once raj posts.
maggie: cool. Lina — when you send the counter, include example numbers for a 10-GPU cluster so Ops can validate onboarding allocation.
lina: will do. thanks everyone :pray:
